# barcodes_QC_plots.R

## barcodes_QC_plots()

```{r}
list_BC1 <- readRDS("data/list_BC1.rds")
list_BC2_3 <- readRDS("data/list_BC2_3.rds")
```

```{r}
barcodes_QC_plots(
  source_dir = "data",
  list_BC1_file_name = "list_BC1.rds",
  list_BC2_3_file_name = "list_BC2_3.rds",
  output_dir = "plots",
  verbose = TRUE
)
```
